visual_review.desktop: The actual Day 21 gallery row shows the clean triptych alongside the exact supplied English description. Title, place labels, scale, OSM attribution and author remain on the artwork; all explanations and evidence callouts are removed.
visual_review.mobile: Description remains readable in the gallery header above the 350 CSS px image. Fine footprint detail and small artwork labels are inspected via the functioning full-size PNG link.
visual_review.reference_choice: Day 20 was inspected but uses a custom full-bleed northeast title arrangement. Day 19 is the latest completed landscape work with the unmodified standard series title hierarchy, complete author line and a compatible canvas.
